bienvenida.texto: Practice investing in the stock market with fictional money. There's no real risk: making mistakes is part of learning. Here's the basics in 1 minute.

dinero.texto: “Available capital” is the cash you can use to buy. “Invested” is what your stocks are worth today. “Total net worth” is both added together, so you can see how you're doing compared to the initial equivalent of {{capital}}.

empresas.texto: Each row is a publicly traded company. Buying a stock means buying a small piece of that company. The green arrow ▲ means its price is rising; the red arrow ▼ means it's falling. Click one to see it on the chart.

grafico.texto: View the live price or explore simulated history for one day, one week, one month, or one year. Historical periods are fictional and do not represent real market quotes.

operar.texto: Choose how many shares you want and click “Buy” or “Sell.” You make money if you sell for more than you paid; if you sell for less, you lose money. You can only buy with your balance and sell shares you own.

portafolio.texto: Here you can see what you own: how many shares, what you paid, and how much you've gained or lost today. That gain is unrealized until you sell.

mentor.texto: Tap “Analyze my decisions” and the Mentor will explain in simple words what you did well, what to improve, and why the market reacted that way. You can also ask questions.

progreso.texto: This tab shows how your capital changes over time. After a few trades, you unlock a quiz to check what you've learned. Happy investing!
